Please note that this position is 100% onsite in Orange, CA.
HOSPITALITY + COMMERCIAL INTERIORS
We are looking for a talented and technically strong Senior Job Captain – Interior Design to join our Interior Design Studio. We are seeking someone with 5–7+ years of professional experience who is highly proficient in Revit and CAD and has hands-on experience developing and coordinating comprehensive Design Development and Construction Document packages including millwork detailing for high-end hospitality and commercial interiors. Our projects include restaurants, hotels, multifamily amenity spaces, clubhouses, lounges, and other commercial and lifestyle environments.
What You'll Do
What We're Looking For
This Role Is Especially Suited For You If...
You enjoy the technical side of interior design as much as the creative side. You can move comfortably between Revit documentation, interior detailing, material selections, consultant coordination, shop drawing review, and field conditions—while understanding the design intent behind every decision. You know that a beautiful hospitality environment is only successful when it is also well detailed, coordinated, durable, and buildable.
Software
Required: Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp
Preferred: Adobe Creative Suite and rendering/visualization software
Education
Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, or a related field preferred. NCIDQ and/or LEED accreditation is a plus.
Portfolio Requirement
Please submit a portfolio with your application demonstrating both design and technical capabilities. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of construction documentation, interior detailing, millwork, and built hospitality/commercial projects in addition to finished design imagery.
Please note: This position is focused on interior architecture, technical design development, construction documentation, and construction administration. Candidates whose experience is primarily FF&E selection, procurement, or styling without significant technical documentation experience may not be the right fit for this role.
Why AO? Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and the belief that great work happens when people are supported and challenged in equal measure. You’ll find a team that values:
- Strong relationships, with clients and each other
- A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality
- Continuous learning and professional growth
- Thoughtful design paired with technical rigor
At AO, you will work alongside colleagues who care deeply about what they do and are committed to building something meaningful together.
Benefits
We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team. Highlights include:
- Medical, dental, life, and supplemental insurance
- Most medical plans fully paid for employee-only coverage
- Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
- Retirement plan, health savings, and flexible spending accounts
- Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
- Free parking and convenient transit access
- Employee discount program (OC location)
